summary: Nadia arrives in Sylhet and finds her brother with a stomach ache.

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.en: Apu, I have a stomach ache.

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.en: I ate a lot of pitha yesterday.

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.en: A lot of pitha! Do you have a fever?

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.bn: না, জ্বর নেই। শুধু পেট ব্যথা।
lines.tr: na, jor nei. shudhu pet byatha.
lines.en: No, no fever. Just a stomach ache.

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.bn: চিন্তা নেই। এই ওষুধ নাও। দিনে দুই বার খাও।
lines.tr: chinta nei. ei oshudh nao. dine dui bar khao.
lines.en: Don't worry. Take this medicine. Take it twice a day.

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.bn: আর আজ বিশ্রাম নাও। পিঠা না!
lines.tr: ar aj bishram nao. pitha na!

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.en: No pitha? That makes me sad.

lines.speaker: Nani
lines.bn: মন খারাপ করিস না। কাল আবার পিঠা খাবি।
lines.tr: mon kharap korish na. kal abar pitha khabi.
lines.en: Don't be sad. Tomorrow you'll have pitha again.

questions.question: Why does his stomach hurt?
options: He ate a lot of pitha yesterday
questions.why: অনেক পিঠা খেলাম = I ate a lot of pitha.

questions.question: How often should Rafi take the medicine?
questions.why: দিনে = a day; বার = times. In Bengali you 'eat' medicine: ওষুধ খাও.

questions.question: What does Nani promise?
options: Tomorrow he can have pitha again
Tomorrow he will go to hospital
questions.why: কাল আবার পিঠা খাবি = tomorrow you'll eat pitha again. Nani uses তুই, the warm, intimate 'you'.
